title: Concrete Slab quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and lay a new concrete shed slab, 6m x 4m (24sqm), 100mm thick, for a backyard shed in Penrith. Scope includes: excavation of 150mm of topsoil, supply and compaction of 100mm DGB20 crushed rock base, a 200 micron poly vapour barrier, SL72 reinforcement mesh, N25 concrete mix (approx. 2.4 cubic metres), edge formwork (20 lineal metres), and one saw-cut control joint across the 4m width (4 lineal metres).
workingDetail: Excavation and levelling, Compacted crushed rock base, Poly vapour barrier, Reinforcement mesh (SL72, SL82, or trench mesh)
